Live coverage on the Sun* Family Facebook Group

More than just a name, “Root Further” embodies the spirit every Sun* member strives for: always looking deeply in every context and constantly innovating, expanding oneself to overcome the limits one has previously set. Drawing on the metaphor of color theory — from just three primary colors: red, yellow, and blue — the boundless creativity of each individual can produce a nearly infinite spectrum of colors, with every shade representing limitless breakthrough and innovation.

A peer recognition and appreciation activity — happening for the first time for all Sunners. The activity will be rolled out in November 2025, encouraging Sun* members to share recognition and appreciation messages with colleagues on the platform announced by the organizing committee. This will serve as input for the Heads Council when selecting award recipients.
